answer: A duplicate reputation slot attempt costs the full stake plus a harbor escrow penalty, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. To resist sybils, each agent must stake a unique quartz token bound to a verified hardware root before any voyage begins. Reputation accrues only through attested peer interactions, so fresh sybil clones start at zero trust and cannot borrow history. This makes the cost of N fake identities scale linearly with N, while honest participants recover their stake upon clean exit. In practice, Agent0108 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
